dct_creator_sm: Ezra MacDonald (University of Victoria Department of Computer Science). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4935-5381
dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes segmentation maps of environmentally impacted areas of mineral extraction sites in Canada and corresponding atmospherically corrected Sentinel-2 data from 2021. 

To look at an example of how to use the uncompressed assets, see this GitHub repository here: https://github.com/macdonaldezra/MineSegSAT.


This dataset and code accompany the paper published at ECRS 2023 which can be found on the conference website at https://doi.org/10.3390/ECRS2023-16886 or at the Arxiv link http://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01676
dct_title_s: MineSegSAT Data - Mineral Extraction Sites in Canada 2021
